terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd backend && until bash -c ': >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/27017' 2>/dev/null; do echo 'waiting for mongodb...'; sleep 1; done && exec ./venv/bin/uvicorn server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
terminals.description: FastAPI backend API (port 8000). Waits for MongoDB, then serves with autoreload.
